data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 claims resumption is 'always safe at any point of exhaustion' under a purely functional model, but the problem explicitly requires determining 'when resumption must stay refused.' The artifact's claim provides no positive refusal criterion — it only notes counterconditions (global-state mutation, irreversible side effects) under which its own claim would be falsified, without translating those into a concrete adjudication of when to refuse. The problem asks to 'adjudicate between rival criteria wherever the evidence allows'; asserting universal safety under idealized assumptions does not adjudicate, it sidesteps the refusal question entirely.
